channel.title: Oracle University Daily
channel.description: A Flipboard-inspired daily magazine covering Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Oracle Database, AI Database, Java, MySQL, NetSuite, Fusion Apps, Oracle Health, certifications, security alerts, earnings, and partner ecosystem news.

item.title: Oracle AI Database and multicloud moves: what architects should watch
item.description: Preview card for the daily edition. Live refresh replaces this with current source-linked coverage from official Oracle feeds and external APIs.

item.title: Critical Patch Update desk: DBA and security teams need a clear watchlist
item.description: Security stories receive higher priority because patch windows, CVEs, and dependency changes affect production risk.

item.title: OCI networking update draws attention from cloud architects
item.description: Flipboard-inspired cards are built for quick scanning, source transparency, topic filtering, and fast click-through to the original report.

item.title: Certification learners look for updated Oracle Cloud learning paths
item.description: Training stories should link to official learning sources and clearly separate editorial context from official certification requirements.

item.title: Java platform news: developers monitor release notes and performance changes
item.description: Developer coverage can sit beside cloud, database, earnings, and security stories in the same daily magazine layout.

item.title: MySQL operations brief: release notes, backup patterns, and cloud compatibility
item.description: The topic engine groups MySQL, Java, GraalVM, and developer ecosystem stories for a focused engineering feed.

item.title: NetSuite and cloud ERP: signals for finance and operations leaders
item.description: Applications coverage includes NetSuite, Fusion Cloud ERP, HCM, SCM, CX, and Oracle Health so enterprise readers can follow product lines together.

item.title: Fusion Cloud HCM brief: agentic workflows, HR data, and rollout readiness
item.description: Enterprise application stories are summarized as briefs with clear original-source links and related-topic navigation.

item.title: ORCL investor watch: earnings, cloud revenue, and AI infrastructure demand
item.description: Business stories are marked separately from product updates so readers can filter market coverage without losing technical news.

item.title: Oracle Health brief: interoperability, clinical workflows, and cloud modernization
item.description: Healthcare technology coverage is grouped with applications but can be promoted when regulatory, interoperability, or patient-care issues matter.

item.title: Exadata and database performance: tuning stories worth saving
item.description: The saved-story feature lets readers build a local reading list without needing accounts, cookies, or a backend database.

item.title: Partner ecosystem brief: integrations, migrations, and customer wins
item.description: External API coverage helps fill the magazine with analyst, partner, and press coverage beyond official Oracle announcements.

item.title: Cloud regions and data residency: why location stories matter
item.description: Regional cloud updates influence latency, compliance, procurement, and disaster recovery planning for enterprise teams.

item.title: GraalVM developer brief: runtime performance and cloud-native packaging
item.description: Developer stories receive topic tags that make them discoverable through search, topic pages, RSS, and structured site navigation.

item.title: Autonomous Database and AI operations: what enterprise teams evaluate
item.description: Database coverage should help architects understand relevance without copying the full original source content.

item.title: How this site turns automated news into a useful daily reading experience
item.description: The system fetches public feeds server-side, deduplicates URLs, classifies stories, generates static pages, and preserves original source links.
